purpose: Seed taxonomy for Hunt 5 operator tagging.

tags.definition: Maps a parameter to reciprocal/cusp/dual modular regime.
Lattice or theta reciprocal summation / Gaussian duality.
examples: sum exp(-beta n^2) -> sqrt(pi/beta) sum exp(-pi^2 k^2/beta)

tags.definition: Product/q-product converted to additive or coefficient series.
Series or recurrence recognized as product/eta/q-product.
Function or constant represented as continued fraction.
Continued fraction expanded to verify or generate sequence terms.
Extracts leading asymptotic plus correction/tail structure.
Uses residue classes as checksum, selection rule, or simplification.
Oscillatory/infinite object collapses under rational phase or finite character sum.
Identity becomes tractable at special values of parameters.
Special identity generalized by parameter family.
Coefficient family computed by recurrence rather than direct expansion.
Moments/traces decomposed into hidden poles and weights via rational generating functions.
Arithmetic periodic basis / divisor-indexed trigonometric sum.
Elliptic/modular/AGM route to faster convergence.
Mock/false/partial theta object plus correction/shadow/completion.
Reindexing/repartitioning that reduces dimension or exposes equality.
Compact identity used mainly as a check/certificate rather than primary computation.
Manipulation visible but not yet classifiable.
Definitions/prose/formula with no visible computational transform.
